description: Recovery approver set vectors: votes and thresholds, revoke and agent rotation, epochs, the threshold following the set, and the limits on what recovery can do.

vectors.description: One recovery member pauses alone under a threshold of 2 and moves nothing, and the principal resumes.
Below the threshold a vote is only recorded; the second member's vote revokes with no transfer, and a member sweeps to the principal.
Two votes rotate an agent for a new account, then one for a guardian, then remove one with no replacement.
A payout queued by an agent the recovery set rotated out cannot execute, and the principal cancels it.
Rotating a non-agent or to an existing agent is CONFIG_INVALID, to any other role holder ROLE_CONFLICT, and none records a vote.
Only recovery members vote, each once per action and epoch, and a revoke and a rotation keep separate tallies.
Each agent, threshold or member change between votes starts a new epoch, so a second vote records a new tally rather than revoking.
A repeat vote is refused within an epoch; after the principal removes an agent the same member votes again and a second member completes the revoke.
Recovery rotates and revokes while paused and after expiry; once revoked every recovery call is MANDATE_REVOKED and a member sweeps.
A recovery member cannot withdraw, change the allowlist, limits, roles or threshold, revoke alone or request; nothing changes.
A recovery vote approves no payout and a payout approval is no recovery vote, even from a member who is also an approver.
set_recovery_threshold outside 1 to the set size, and removing a member below the threshold, are CONFIG_INVALID until it is lowered.
create refuses a threshold of 0 with members, above 0 with none, or above the set size; the same salt then creates the mandate.
The first member raises the threshold to 1, a second leaves it, removing the last resets it to 0, and a lone re-added member needs its one vote.
With no members only 0 fits; adding the first member sets 1, after which 0 is refused and one vote no longer revokes once 2 is set.
After the threshold is lowered the members are removed one by one; the last removal resets it to 0 and former members can no longer act.
